difficulty_reason: Only specified open permissions are self-service; most other permissions and partner programs require explicit LinkedIn approval.
effort: Create a developer application, add an available product, configure HTTPS callback URLs, then request access to gated products or permissions when the use case requires them.
prerequisites: An HTTPS callback URL for the 3-legged OAuth flow.
Some API products require explicit approval or partner program access.

steps.title: Create a developer app
steps.instruction: Create an app in the LinkedIn Developer Portal and review the products available to it.

steps.title: Check whether your product is open
steps.instruction: LinkedIn lists OpenID Connect profile/email and Share on LinkedIn w_member_social as open permissions; other products may require approval.

steps.title: Configure OAuth callback
steps.instruction: In the Auth tab add an absolute HTTPS callback URL with no fragment.

steps.title: Request gated access if needed
steps.instruction: Use the developer portal product request flow and provide the requested business/use-case information. Approval is not guaranteed by this guide.

approval.review_needed: Most permissions and partner programs require explicit LinkedIn approval. Open Permissions are listed as available to all developers.
approval.triggers: Products such as Advertising API and specialized partner APIs require approval or partner access.
approval.checks: Access eligibility depends on the product/program and permission. Exact review rubric is not established in the cited overview.
approval.slow_factors: No general review duration was established in the cited official pages.

blockers.problem: The product you need is not available in your app
blockers.fix: Check its access program and submit the product request in the developer portal; some programs require explicit approval.
Use an absolute HTTPS URL registered under the app's Auth tab; remove URL fragments.

scopes.name: profile, email, w_member_social
scopes.why: Listed by LinkedIn as open permissions available to all developers via self-service products.

scopes.name: Advertising API and other partner permissions
scopes.why: LinkedIn says Advertising API access requires approval; other listed permissions/programs may require approval.

redirect_rules: LinkedIn's 3-legged OAuth documentation requires an absolute HTTPS callback URL. URL parameters are ignored and fragments are invalid.
agent_handoff: An agent can map a use case to published products and prepare a request draft. A human must create the app, sign in, provide company/use-case information, and request or negotiate partner access.
next_action: Match your planned feature to LinkedIn's product and permission list; determine whether an open permission covers it before investing in a gated API.

evidence.claim: LinkedIn says most permissions/programs require explicit approval and identifies open permissions.
evidence.label: SOURCED

evidence.claim: 3-legged OAuth callback URLs must be absolute HTTPS URLs; parameters are ignored and fragments are invalid.
evidence.label: SOURCED
